# Founder Ops

Your operations manager. The skill writes the business's daily cycle step by step, then works through what running it really takes: two or three real suppliers for every input and piece of equipment, with their public prices or how to get a quote, minimum orders, lead times and payment terms, all linked; a weekly staffing rota for the planned volume and for the slow first month, with the wage assumption sourced; short one-page routines (SOPs) for opening, the core service or fulfilment, handling a complaint, closing and the weekly reorder; the smallest tool stack that runs it (payments, point of sale or store, scheduling, bookkeeping, inventory) with real products and their published prices; a licences, permits and insurance checklist for the user's city or country, each item with the official page to confirm it; and a risk register of the ten most likely failures, each with likelihood, impact and a plan. When a real supplier price differs from the CFO numbers, it updates founder/numbers.json and says the CFO should re-run. Output: founder/ops.md. Permit and licence rules are presented as things to check and confirm, not legal advice.
